resources.string: To read the screen and dispatch input it relies on Shizuku, an open-source tool that grants ADB-level (developer/debugging) access without root. Used only for what the paired client requests, and only for apps you\'ve explicitly granted.

Nothing can happen until you connect Shizuku, pair a client, arm the app, and grant specific packages. Sessions are time-limited, shown in an ongoing notification you can stop anytime, and logged while open. An empty grant list leaves the app unable to touch anything.
By continuing, you agree to let MCPserved use Shizuku\'s device-control access for this purpose.
